subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Vocabulary e.g. taxi, passenger, town, street, bus stop, clinic, driver, petrol station, sidewalk, safe, unsafe, warning

show.line: Let's go to town! We ride in a taxi. We stop at the shop.

rounds.praise: Yes! The taxi takes us to town.

rounds.prompt: Where do we go when we are sick?
rounds.praise: Yes! The clinic helps sick people.

rounds.prompt: Who drives the taxi? Say it.
Which one is safe? Crossing at the robot, or running in the street?
rounds.praise: Yes! Cross at the robot. It is safe.

rounds.prompt: Is it safe or unsafe? Sort the pictures.

hints: Look at the picture. Where are they?
Safe means no one gets hurt.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name this place.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It is the petrol station. Cars get petrol there.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Cars get petrol here. Petrol station!

parent_line: Can name places in town in English and tell safe from unsafe.
